cues: Finally, what happens when the message itself changes.
A mutation is a sudden, random, heritable change in the genetic material, not caused by segregation or recombination.
Hugo de Vries coined the word in nineteen oh one, from the evening primrose.
Mutations are usually recessive and usually harmful, because a random change to a finely tuned system is more likely to break it than to improve it.
text: Finally, what happens when the message itself changes. A mutation is a sudden, random, heritable change in the genetic material, not caused by segregation or recombination. Hugo de Vries coined the word in nineteen oh one, from the evening primrose. Mutations are usually recessive and usually harmful, because a random change to a finely tuned system is more likely to break it than to improve it. And they are rare.
